quarterly_data.signal: Orders (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026, as of 2026-06-30): the only order the company discloses is the supply contract announced 2026-06-08 for HBM4-manufacturing 'TC BONDER 4.5 GRIFFIN' equipment, total KRW 44,200,000,000, delivery due 2026-09-02 (delivery date may change by agreement with the customer); amount delivered and remaining backlog columns are left blank. The counterparty is NOT named in the report (the filing states that orders and contract terms are not disclosed beyond mandatory single-sale/supply-contract disclosures because they would expose customers' investment plans; only orders of 5%+ of prior-year revenue are disclosed; some orders are withheld at customer request and this was reported to the standing auditor). Working-capital evidence of a heavy Q2 shipment wave: trade receivables KRW 258,347M at 2026-06-30 vs KRW 62,375M at 2025-12-31 (4.1x; 93.2% not yet due, KRW 15,582M up to 6 months overdue), receivables by region Asia KRW 249,115M / North America KRW 4,073M / Europe KRW 4,055M / South America KRW 1,704M; contract liabilities KRW 6,429M incl. KRW 4,271M under the new 'Hanmi Credit' customer-loyalty programme (credits on equipment orders redeemable over ~5 years, first booked this half). Standard export terms: 30% T/T 30 days after PO, 60% T/T 30 days before delivery, 10% T/T 30 days after acceptance, FOB Korea; domestic cash/notes ~7:3, cash due 30 days after sign-off. DISCLOSED CUSTOMER LIST: SK Hynix, Micron Technology, ASE, Amkor, JCET, Huatian Technology, TFME, Infineon, ST Micro, PTI, Skyworks, Luxshare overseas; JCET STATS ChipPAC Korea, ASE Korea, Amkor Korea, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, LG Innotek, Korea Circuit, SFA Semiconductor, Signetics domestic. Sales run through HANMI Taiwan / HANMI Vietnam / HANMI Singapore subsidiaries and 16 overseas agents; Hanmi Taiwan H1 revenue KRW 18,305M (net income KRW 4,371M).

quarterly_data.signal: Products / pipeline (DART half-year report filed 08-14-2026): the HBM TC (thermal-compression) bonder for 12/16-high stacks stays the core; the filing repeats that because the memory industry's HYBRID-BONDER development is DELAYED by technical hurdles, 20-high+ HBM needs a new tool able to bond WIDER dies, so a 'WIDE TC BONDER' launch is imminent, while hybrid bonders for HBM production and for system-semiconductor stacking are developed in parallel. Commercialised TC bonder line-up now listed as TC BONDER 4.5 GRIFFIN (HBM4), TC BONDER 4.0 TIGER, 2.5D TC BONDER 120, 2.5D TC BONDER 40 C2W, 2.5D TC BONDER 40 C2S and the world-first two-in-one BOC COB BONDER (stacked GDDR, enterprise eSSD); FLIP CHIP BONDER family (FC BONDER 3.0/3.5/5.0/75, MULTI DIE BONDER 2.0); 6-SIDE INSPECTION for pre/post-TC-bond HBM yield control; META GRINDER; entry into AI-semiconductor 2.5D PACKAGING (TC/FC/die bonders integrating core HBM 12/16-high + base die + CPU/GPU on a silicon interposer). micro SAW & VISION PLACEMENT (world #1 since the mid-2000s) is seeing rising demand from the traditional-semiconductor recovery, and the MSVP 8.0 PCB-cutting series (515mm x 515mm panels for 2.5D, PLP and chiplet packages) is driving sales growth; EMI SHIELD 2.0 X (#1 share since 2016) targets aerospace, LEO satcom, defence drones and smart devices. Corporate: 'HBM TC BONDER' named a World-Class Product (2025-11) and the company received the USD 300M Export Tower (2025-12); NICE D&B credit rating AA0 dated 2026-04-21 (valid to 2027-04-20); electronic voting adopted at the 2026-03-20 AGM. Patent litigation with rival TC-bonder vendor HANWHA SEMITECH is pending both ways: Hanmi v. Hanwha Semitech (Seoul Central District Court 2024Gahap113542, filed 2024-12-04, claim KRW 2,500M, infringement injunction and damages) and Hanwha Semitech v. Hanmi (2025Gahap12443, filed 2025-07-25, claim KRW 1,200M). Share price: monthly average rose from KRW 177,390 (Jan 2026) to KRW 348,889 (May 2026), closing KRW 256,500 on 2026-06-30; H1 TSR 102.0%. Largest shareholder Kwak Dong-shin and 7 related parties 55.79%; NPS 5.43%.
